d:
I've just released the English translation for this. If a translator of a different tongue happens upon this, you no doubt see that this work of literature begs your gentle touch.

If doing so, please take care to include the POMF from the first panel of page 22, in whatever form this may take in your language.

I've left the hearts in place, because they come in many shapes and sizes. I found it sufficient to move them around after placing text on each page.

Note the shoddy wall pattern at the top-left of page 32. I found that placing text on this made it unnoticeable.
n: [Doujinshi] [Uniyaa (Ikinari Mojio)] Kusozako Sourou Maou wa Chouchoushin no Mucchimuchi Dekashiri Majo ni mo Makeppanashi [Textless]
